# KMP Terminal Emulator

> Kotlin Multiplatform (KMP) terminal emulator engine and Compose Multiplatform GPU-accelerated canvas renderer.

## Architecture
- `terminal-core`: Pure Kotlin Multiplatform emulation state machine, screen buffer, ANSI parser, and text selection models. Zero UI dependencies.
- `terminal-ui`: Compose Multiplatform canvas renderer, gesture detectors, platform native input capture, and selection overlays.

## Core API References
- [Core Configuration](terminal-core/src/commonMain/kotlin/com/johnan/terminal/core/TerminalConfig.kt): `TerminalConfig`, `terminalConfig { ... }`, `BellBehavior`
- [UI Configuration](terminal-ui/src/commonMain/kotlin/com/johnan/terminal/ui/TerminalUiConfig.kt): `TerminalUiConfig`, `terminalUiConfig { ... }`, `LocalTerminalUiConfig`, `TerminalCursorStyle`
- [Terminal Emulator](terminal-core/src/commonMain/kotlin/com/johnan/terminal/core/TerminalEmulator.kt): `TerminalEmulator`, `screenState`, `processOutput`, `copyToClipboard`
- [Terminal Renderer](terminal-ui/src/commonMain/kotlin/com/johnan/terminal/ui/TerminalRenderer.kt): `TerminalRenderer` composable
- [Text Selection](terminal-core/src/commonMain/kotlin/com/johnan/terminal/core/TerminalSelection.kt): `TerminalSelection`, `SelectionState`
